'''Red Squadron 7''' was an [[Incom Corporation/Legends|Incom Corporation]] [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing starfighter]] in service to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The fighter was part of [[Red Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Red Squadron]] during the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], piloted by [[Keir Santage/Legends|Keir Santage]]. Previously, the fighter had participated in [[Sorties against Fondor Shipyards|twelve sorties]] against the [[Fondor Shipyards/Legends|Fondor Shipyards]].<ref name="CCG-Red7" />

During the Battle of Endor, Red Squadron 7 joined [[General/Legends|General]] [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian's]] strike force that entered the superstructure of the [[Death Star II/Legends|second Death Star]]. While maneuvering through the tight confines, the fighter was destroyed by [[Laser/Legends|laser]] fire from a pursing [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE fighter]].<ref name="ROTJ" />
